title: Domestic Animal Image Classification System
shortDescription: A 9-class domestic animal classifier built with PyTorch transfer learning, dataset quality assurance, leakage detection, and systematic model comparison.
longDescription: A complete computer vision pipeline for classifying 9 domestic animal species from a custom-cleaned dataset. The project covers dataset quality assurance, corruption and format analysis, exact duplicate removal, cross-split near-duplicate investigation, class balancing, augmentation, transfer learning, fine-tuning, and final evaluation. Perceptual hashing and ORB feature matching were used to investigate near-duplicate leakage before training. ResNet50 and EfficientNet-B0 were trained using a two-stage transfer-learning strategy, with ResNet50 achieving the best final performance at 95.95% test accuracy and 94.96% macro F1.
features: 9-Class Classification: Recognizes Buffalo, Camel, Cat, Chicken, Donkey, Goat, Horse, Pig, and Sheep.
Dataset Quality Assurance: Analyzed image integrity, dimensions, formats, color modes, class distribution, duplicates, and near-duplicate relationships.
Leakage Detection: Used pHash for near-duplicate discovery and ORB feature matching for visual verification across dataset splits.
Transfer Learning: Compared ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 and EfficientNet-B0 using staged training and fine-tuning.
Class Imbalance Handling: Combined dataset redistribution, augmentation, and weighted random sampling.
Model Evaluation: Compared accuracy, macro precision, macro recall, macro F1, weighted F1, and confusion matrices.

metrics: AI Symptom Triage • Automated Scheduling • Invoicing
title: AI-Powered Doctor Appointment Automation System
shortDescription: An end-to-end healthcare automation platform combining AI symptom intake, doctor matching, appointment scheduling, notifications, and automated invoicing.
longDescription: An end-to-end healthcare workflow system built around n8n, Supabase/PostgreSQL, and a web frontend. The platform combines AI-assisted symptom intake and doctor specialization matching with automated appointment booking, availability handling, notification workflows, and invoice generation. Separate orchestration and worker workflows connect webhooks, database procedures, and AI reasoning into a single operational pipeline. PostgreSQL functions handle doctor availability and booking rules while n8n coordinates the automation between user requests, scheduling, notifications, and billing.
features: AI Symptom Intake: Processes patient symptom descriptions and determines medical specialization and urgency categories.
Doctor Matching: Uses AI-assisted reasoning to map symptoms to supported medical specializations.
Automated Scheduling: Generates available slots and books appointments using PostgreSQL scheduling logic.
Workflow Orchestration: Uses webhook-driven n8n workflows for appointment, notification, and backend operations.
Automated Invoicing: Generates invoices for completed appointments with calculated tax and payment status.
Database Integration: Uses Supabase/PostgreSQL tables, functions, constraints, and indexes for persistent workflow state.

metrics: Modular NLP API • TF-IDF Similarity Search
title: NLP Text Processing & Document Similarity API
shortDescription: A modular FastAPI NLP backend for linguistic analysis, named entity extraction, TF-IDF document vectors, similarity matching, and embedding visualization.
longDescription: A modular NLP backend application built with FastAPI that exposes a complete text-processing and document-similarity workflow through API endpoints. The system performs tokenization, lemmatization, stemming, part-of-speech tagging, and named entity recognition, then transforms documents into TF-IDF vectors for similarity analysis. Query vectors are compared against a custom corpus using cosine similarity, while PCA and t-SNE projections provide 2D visualization of the document vector space. The backend separates routing, schemas, NLP processing, and embedding logic for a cleaner service-oriented architecture.
features: Lexical Processing: Supports tokenization, lemmatization, and stemming through dedicated API endpoints.
Linguistic Analysis: Uses spaCy for part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition.
Document Vectorization: Converts corpus documents into TF-IDF vectors for numerical text representation.
Similarity Search: Uses cosine similarity to retrieve the nearest documents for an input query.
Embedding Visualization: Projects document vectors into 2D space using PCA or t-SNE.
API Architecture: Uses FastAPI with separated routes, schemas, and service modules.

metrics: Bilingual Platform • Real-Time Admin • Booking & E-Commerce
title: Mehndi Mastery Studio
shortDescription: A production-oriented bilingual business platform with real-time content management, booking, e-commerce, and role-based administration.
longDescription: A full-stack business platform designed for a home-based mehndi studio, combining a public bilingual website with a real administrative system. The platform allows the business owner to manage website content, galleries, courses, products, bookings, inquiries, and branding without editing code. Supabase provides PostgreSQL data storage, authentication, storage, realtime synchronization, and row-level security, while the React frontend implements the public experience and admin dashboard. The project demonstrates practical product engineering, business logic, role-based access, and owner-oriented content management.
features: Owner-Managed CMS: Allows non-technical users to manage website content and business information without redeployment.
Bilingual Experience: Supports English and Simplified Chinese throughout the platform.
Booking System: Handles availability, blocked dates, group limits, and appointment requests.
E-Commerce: Supports products, categories, cart workflows, discounts, and inventory status.
Role-Based Administration: Uses Supabase Auth, roles, and row-level security for protected admin operations.
Realtime Backend: Uses Supabase Realtime and PostgreSQL-backed data synchronization.

metrics: TF-IDF Ranking • Positional Indexing • Boolean Retrieval
title: Information Retrieval & Search Engine Foundations
shortDescription: A Python implementation of core information-retrieval techniques including indexing, Boolean search, TF-IDF ranking, and vector-space similarity.
longDescription: A practical implementation of core Information Retrieval concepts using Python. The project covers the complete path from text preprocessing and inverted-index construction to Boolean retrieval and similarity-based ranking. It implements positional indexes for phrase queries, TF-IDF weighting, vector-space document representations, and cosine-similarity ranking. The work also explores posting-list compression using gap encoding, variable-byte encoding, and Golomb encoding, providing a foundation for understanding classical search systems and modern retrieval pipelines.
features: Text Preprocessing: Applies tokenization, stopword removal, stemming, and lemmatization.
Inverted Indexing: Builds term-to-document posting lists for efficient retrieval.
Positional Indexing: Stores term positions to support phrase-query matching.
Boolean Retrieval: Implements AND, OR, and NOT query operations.
TF-IDF Ranking: Represents documents as weighted vectors based on term importance.
Similarity Search: Uses cosine similarity to rank documents against user queries.
Index Compression: Explores gap encoding, variable-byte encoding, and Golomb encoding.

title: Automated Cattle Body Condition Scoring
shortDescription: An edge-oriented computer vision pipeline exploring landmark localization and visual feature analysis for automated livestock body condition assessment.
longDescription: An applied computer vision project exploring automated cattle body condition assessment from visual inputs. The system focuses on identifying important body regions and skeletal or contour-based cues that can contribute to non-invasive livestock health assessment. The project combines OpenCV preprocessing with deep learning approaches while considering efficient inference for practical edge-based deployment. The broader goal is to support automated livestock monitoring and smart agriculture applications.
features: Landmark Localization: Identifies body regions and visual cues relevant to body condition analysis.
Computer Vision Pipeline: Combines image preprocessing, feature extraction, and deep learning.
Edge-Oriented Design: Considers inference efficiency for practical deployment scenarios.
Smart Agriculture Application: Applies computer vision to livestock monitoring and farm analytics.
